title: Grant Application: Budget and Justification
key_sentences: The budget below follows the funder's template, and every line is explained in the justification that follows it.
Salary lines assume a 3 per cent annual increase from the second year.
All figures are in United States dollars and exclude sales tax.
The trust confirms that no part of this request is funded from another public source.

rows: 14 km of the Millrace river, Eastfield district
Indirect costs at 12 per cent of direct costs
Landowner agreements signed for all 14 km
First 4 km of bank re-profiled and planted
Mid-term review and published monitoring report
Independent evaluation delivered to the funder

list_items.text: 1) The project manager coordinates landowners, contractors and the volunteer programme across all three years.
2) The field ecologist carries out the monthly water quality survey and the annual plant and bird counts.
3) Four sondes are needed so that two survey teams can work at the same time on different reaches.
4) The independent evaluation in year 3 is carried out by a university team chosen by open tender.
• Flood events delaying bank works: the contractor schedule leaves a four-week reserve each autumn.
• Loss of volunteers: a paid outreach officer keeps the volunteer register and runs monthly events.
• Invasive species returning: a three-year monitoring plan is built into the ecologist's duties.
